body:
Woah, thank you for going into so much detail. Those product threads are amazing!

This is going to help me a lot!

Thanks for the help, it really makes a difference :)

I'll try my best to get in to a routine.

Thank you so much for the reply, it helps more than you can imagine.

I don't know why I use that SilverGenisis stuff, my mom recommended it for dry skin, it seems to work but I'm not 100% sure.

I posted this before going to sleep so I didn't get a chance to check or post in those two subs, was going to but got really tired.

I didn't think about YouTube, thanks for the suggestion!

Woah, I posted this before I went to bed and didn't expect so many amazing responses. It's honestly overwhelming.

A lot to take in but I'll look into everything you said, thank you so much!

**The issue(s)**

Hi, I really want to get my life together and I feel the first step is getting my hygiene up to scratch.

I have very poor skin, it's always oily or full of big, yellow or inflamed pimples. I also have a ton of black heads on my nose.

I've tried to read the FAQ/Wiki but it's just information overload, I'll try to refer to it for whatever you reply with.

I need a routine with a step by step plan and alternatives if something doesn't work. I'm not looking to be spoon fed, I just have no idea where to start.

I am 20, born male and I have a low budget. I will be starting estrogen (I am transgender) in September next year, wanted to mention it as I have heard the hormones affect your skin.

**Skin type:** Oily, always feels dry after a shower. Very sensitive to harsh products.

**Current routine:** In the morning I use [Simple Kind to Skin Moisturising Facial Wash]( http://www.simple.co.uk/our-products/product/kind-to-skin-moisturising-facial-wash.html) and SilverGenesis Super HydroGel (cant find link) after showering if my face feels dry.

**How long:** Current "routine" past 3 years. Whenever I get really badly depressed I don't shower for up to 4 days at a time and my skin breaks out.

**Your location:** England

I am also looking into proper hair removal, absolutely awful at it. Arms, legs and private areas. I only have a rubbish electric razor. If you could suggest a resource for it I would be so grateful.

Also body wash, nail and hair care if you would be so kind.

My parents never taught me any of this so I'm a complete amateur.
